you.title: Getting set up: you
you.tip: Tell your Chief of Staff what to call you. Your email is optional and only brings your setup guide and news.

whatIsHere.title: Getting set up: what is here
whatIsHere.tip: The AI tools already on this computer. The one marked using this now is the one answering you.

fluxRouter.title: Getting set up: Flux Router
fluxRouter.tip: One key adds the latest AI models, 500+ apps like Gmail, Slack, Notion and GitHub, pictures and talking instead of typing. Not now is fine when something else is already answering.

firstJob.title: Getting set up: your first job
firstJob.tip: Pick one job and the Chief does it now. It asks only for what that job needs, when it needs it.

done.title: Getting set up: done
done.tip: You are set up. Ask for anything, hire a teammate, or reach your bots from your phone. Type /setup to see this list again.
